profile.ja: 人魔問わず斬り殺す殺人鬼として、米連国内で恐れられた人物。残虐非道な行いで有名であり、捕まるまでの間に１００人以上の人魔が惨殺された。その手口から、魔族の犯行ではないかと目されていたが、捕まったのは教師として働く女性ソニア。逮捕時には血しぶきを浴びているショッキングな姿が米連中に放映された。すぐに裁判が行われ、死刑になった――ということになっているが、それは表向き。彼女の才能に目をつけた米連の研究者が持ちかけた取引にのり、ソニアは人造人間になって生まれ変わった。その後は裏の世界に足を踏み入れ、米連に仇なす魔族や人を切り殺している。そんなソニアに新たな潜入・抹殺任務が与えられる。面倒くさそうにしていたソニアだが、『教師として日本の学園への潜入任務』と聞くと「懐かしいわね」と不敵に笑う。かつての惨劇は日本でもニュースになった為「ソフィア」という偽名を名乗り着任した彼女は、すぐに美人教師として人気になり、授業だけでなく部活動の顧問としても熱心に活動する。
profile.en: They are a ruthless killer who has been feared throughout the country for their ability to slaughter both humans and demons without hesitation. They are notorious for their brutal methods, and over 100 people have been brutally murdered before they were caught. Due to the nature of their crimes, it was suspected that they might be a demon, but the one who was arrested was a female teacher named Sonia. Her shocking appearance, covered in blood, was broadcasted nationwide. She was quickly put on trial and sentenced to death - or so it seemed. In reality, a researcher from the country who had taken notice of her talents proposed a deal, and Sonia was reborn as an artificial human being. Since then, she has been active in the underworld, killing demons and people who are enemies of the country. Sonia has been given a new mission - to infiltrate and eliminate a target. At first, she seemed uninterested, but when she heard that the mission involved infiltrating a Japanese school as a teacher, she smiled slyly and said, "It's been a while." Due to the notoriety of her past crimes, she used the alias "Sophia" and quickly became popular as a beautiful teacher. She was not only dedicated to her classes but also actively participated in club activities as an advisor.

text.ja: あら、奇遇ね――なにをしているかって？　顧問よ、野球部の。ちょうどいいわ、あなたも入部なさい……たっぷりと扱いてあげる
text.en: What a coincidence - what brings you here? I'm the advisor for the baseball club. It's perfect - why don't you join the club too? I'll take good care of you.

text.ja: 学校……ふふ、昔を思い出すわ。こう見えても教師は本職だったのよ？　そう、あの時まで……ふふっ――アハハハハッ！
text.en: I'm reminded of the past when I think of school... haha, despite my appearance, being a teacher was my true profession? Yes, until that time... haha... ahahahah!

text.ja: 潜入任務をこなすには徹底しなきゃよ。お仕事とは言え、若人たちを朝から晩まで扱き抜くなんて、心が痛むわぁ
text.en: To carry out infiltration missions, I have to be thorough. Even if it's just work, dealing with young people from morning till night is exhausting, and it hurts my heart.

text.ja: あははははっ、それっ、そぉーれっ！　休んでるヒマはないわよっ！　ノックで死にたくなかったら、立って捕球することね！
text.en: Ahahahah, that's it, that's it! I don't have time to rest! If you don't want to die from being knocked out, stand up and catch it!

text.ja: 野球のユニフォームなんて初めて着たけど、結構ボディラインがでるのよね。若い男達には目に毒かしら？
text.en: I've never worn a baseball uniform before, but it shows off my body line quite a bit. Is it poisonous to young men's eyes?

text.ja: 普段の鉤爪が一番好みだけど、バットで思い切りガツンってするのも、これはこれで悪くないわぁ～……♪
text.en: I usually prefer my claws, but using a bat to hit something with all my might is not so bad... it's actually kind of nice...

text.ja: 野球に詳しいのかって？　そんなわけないでしょう。ただ、人でもボールでも叩いて吹っ飛ばすのは好きよ♪
text.en: Do I know a lot about baseball? Of course not. But I do love hitting people or balls and sending them flying!

text.ja: 人間を思いっきり打ったらどこまで飛ぶのかしら……ねえ、急に正面スタンドまで飛んでみたくなったりしてない？
text.en: I wonder how far a person would fly if I hit them with all my might... hey, don't you suddenly feel like flying all the way to the front stand?

text.ja: こういうド直球な物言いは、好きじゃないけど……ふふっ……あなたのバット、すごく硬くて立派ねぇ。たっぷりと、磨いてあげる
text.en: I don't like straightforward talk like that... but haha... your bat is really hard and impressive. I'll take my time to polish it for you.

text.ja: オナニーのこと、センズリって言うじゃない？　だったらこれは、千本ノックならぬ千本ズリね……ほぉら、しっかり我慢なさい？
text.en: Isn't onanism called "senzuri"? Then this is like "senzuri" with a thousand knocks... come on, endure it and don't make a sound?

text.ja: 白いのを飛ばすのは得意なのねぇ……こぉんなに濃いので、私のことドロドロにしちゃって……この格好、そんなに興奮したの？
text.en: I'm good at hitting white balls, huh... and you're getting all excited and drooly just from this outfit... are you that turned on?
